component.name: App Uninstaller
component.summary: View and remove installed applications and packages

description.p: A lightweight and intuitive graphical manager for viewing and uninstalling applications and system packages on Linux.

ul.li: Multi-format support: RPM (dnf/yum), Flatpak, Snap, APT (dpkg), Pacman, and Zypper
Application filter showing all packages or only GUI apps with icons
Fast live search and column sorting
Package summary and disk size inspection
Built-in protection against removing critical system packages

description.p: Full English interface, custom confirmation dialogs, and AppStream metadata for Flathub.
